subject: planner: reduce NewPlanCacheKey allocations with sync.Pool (#65072)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on `pkg/planner/core`: `NewPlanCacheKey` now reuses temporary `[]byte`/`[]int64` via `zeropool` and encodes several booleans as single bytes. The returned cache key is built via `string(hash)` (copy), so pooled buffers do not escape; no correctness/semantics/concurrency Blocker/High issues found. Later upstream/master further refactored `NewPlanCacheKey` (e.g. #65361), but not as a correctness fix for this commit.
